steps.hint: The SAFETY panel is straight ahead. Look at it until the gaze ring fills; that means you have found it.
READY is the left button on the SAFETY panel. Look at it until the gaze ring fills, then tap to press it.
The TEST SWITCH is the middle control on the SAFETY panel. Tap it once and check its label reads ON.
The TEST DIAL is the right-hand control on the SAFETY panel. Each tap turns it one mark, from 1 to 2.
The CHECK TOOL is on your left. Look at it and tap to grab it; it stays in your hand until you place it.

steps.instruction: Place the CHECK TOOL in the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: The TOOL BAY is on your right. Look at it while holding the CHECK TOOL, then tap; only that tool fits.
